subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark(?) in the following equation?

5.18 × 4 + 2.06 × 5 - 10 ÷ 2 + 1 = ?
solution:
**Given expression:**

5.18 × 4 + 2.06 × 5 - 10 ÷ 2 + 1 = ?

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d6e894f5f2bd077c037c5e36c96aaab0163c440ab6a027748b2571dce190f7c.png] 

 This question will be solved by using **BODMAS **rule.

**Calculation:**

5.18 × 4 + 2.06 × 5 - (10 ÷ 2) + 1

Taking approximation: 5 × 4 + 2 × 5 - 5 + 1

⇒ 20 + 10 - 5 + 1 = 26</p&
gt;

The correct answer is **26.**
